Native hook regression fixtures derived from captured Codex and Kimi events. Project/transcript paths, session identifiers and prompt text have been replaced with examples while preserving the event shapes needed by the tests. No accounts, authentication data or transcripts are included. These fixtures test the reader; they do not certify live provider availability or an agy native payload.

`kimi-StopFailure.json` was captured on 2026-11-15 from a real Kimi run refused for its subscription; only the project path is substituted.
